_about: The islands' perks (core/perk_state.gd; game/perk_machine.gd is the machine). limit = most perks carried at once (the boss's perk power-up ignores it); all are lost when you go down. Each perk: name, price in points, island + at [x, z] from that island's middle (its machine; it faces the island's middle), color, desc (shown at the machine), and its numbers. Machines work once the power is on. Every name, price and number is the director's to change. (polish1 item 37) Each machine has its own model (tools/blender/perk_machines.py: size, shape and this colour tell them apart from afar); colours were spread so no two are alike. Second Wind (polish1, director's option 3): no self-revive any more (that is Quick Revive's); below `burst_below` of your health a burst: `burst_seconds` at `burst_speed` and `burst_heal` of your health back, at most once every `burst_cooldown` s. Quick Revive (batch 2-3): alone it gets you up by yourself `self_revives` times a game, then its machine is gone; online, down, you hold on `down_time_mult` times as long before you bleed out (the perks go when you go down, so it is read at that moment).

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: Help a teammate up twice as fast. When your health drops below 30 %: a second wind (4 s of running faster and a quarter of your health back), at most once every 45 s.

trade_winds.name: Trade Winds
trade_winds.desc: Sprint a quarter faster, and nothing slows you down (frost, slowing hits, poison).

blast_proof.name: Blast Proof
blast_proof.desc: Fire and blasts hurt you half as much (the fire pit, burning, Bad Blood, the Closing Ring), and landing from high up throws a shockwave.

steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
steady_hand.desc: Headshots hit half again as hard; steadier from the hip.

deep_pockets.name: Deep Pockets
deep_pockets.desc: Ammo pools hold half again as much, magazines a fifth more.

run_and_gun.name: Run and Gun
run_and_gun.desc: Aiming down sights no longer slows you, and a finished reload makes you a fifth faster for 2 s.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: Some kills hand you rounds for the gun in hand; power-ups last half again as long.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.desc: An enemy that hits you is set alight and thrown back (every 5 s).

thick_skin.name: Thick Skin
thick_skin.desc: Armour counts double; burning, poison and slow last half as long.

cold_blood.name: Cold Blood
cold_blood.desc: The first shot after 3 s without firing hits twice as hard and goes exactly where you aim.

lucky_strike.name: Lucky Strike
lucky_strike.desc: One kill in ten pays double; power-ups drop a quarter more often.

quick_revive.name: Quick Revive
quick_revive.desc: Down, you hold on twice as long for a teammate. Alone: you get back up by yourself, three times a game; after the third the machine is gone.
